newsitem.title: SPAIN: Child prostitution ring uncovered in Barcelona.
newsitem.headline: Child prostitution ring uncovered in Barcelona.

text.p: Spanish police said on Tuesday they had arrested a number of people suspected of involvement in a child prostitution ring in Barcelona.
Media reports put the number of arrests at 10 and said some parents may have consented to prostituting their children for money.
Spanish state radio quoted sources close to the investigation as saying at least 40 children, aged five to 14, were exploited in one of the poorest districts of the Catalan capital.

A spokeswoman for the Barcelona municipality said a Socialist official from the impoverished district of Ciutat Vella, where the ring allegedly operated, was among those arrested. She said he was stripped of his position on Tuesday and expelled from his party.
"There have been some arrests," a police spokeswoman told Reuters. She said she could not provide any further details on the case because a judge had declared all proceedings secret.
The radio said a school headmaster, teachers, a doctor and owners of some apartments used for child prostitution were among those arrested over the past week.
Photographs and videos of paedophiles in sex acts with the children were also found, local media reports said.

The daily El Pais said police uncovered the first clue to the ring when they arrested a couple in June who rented out their 10-year-old son as a prostitute at weekends for 30,000 pesetas ($200). The family lived in Ciutat Vella.
The parents, who were reported to have sometimes received payment in alcoholic beverages, were freed on probation last week.
